$comment: Engine catalog — English (the only launch locale, ADR 0019). Keys are dotted, area-first. Values use {param} placeholders; plurals are objects keyed by CLDR category selected via a 'count' param. Adding a locale = adding a sibling file (e.g. pt-BR.json); zero code changes. i18n/keys.gen.json (generated by apigen + the i18n lint) inventories every key referenced from code; CI fails on keys missing here.
